title: Common providers: Slovakia
coverage: Complete for the four mobile network operators (three sell fixed lines) and the main cable operator; business ISPs and regional operators are partial.
missing: Regional cable, fibre and wireless ISPs
An AS number for O2 Slovakia (its registry record holds none) and the network company behind it

sources.name: RÚ (Regulatory Authority for Electronic Communications and Postal Services)
sources.terms: The page was requested on the read date; its reuse terms were not read (they are in the national language), so nothing is copied.
sources.result: The home page answered on the read date; the register of undertakings was not found by an automated read. It is the authority to consult for operators this pack lacks.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Telecommunications in Slovakia
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 4 of 10 entries were found on the page, by their name or a distinctive other name.

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 10 of 10 websites answered an automated check; an address that did not answer is left empty. No support or status page was checked.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat terms forbid redistributing RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, that the registered holder is the named provider.
sources.result: 10 AS numbers confirmed, each announced on the read date; a number whose holder was another company is listed only where the note says whose it is.

sources.name: RIPE Database (RIPE NCC): organisation and aut-num objects
sources.terms: The RIPE Database terms were not re-read for this pack; it is treated like RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to find which AS numbers an organisation holds.
sources.result: Read to find candidate AS numbers; each was then confirmed as above.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

sources.name: Press reports on the SWAN mergers
sources.terms: Cited for a date and a name (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: Read on the date above: SWAN and SWAN Mobile (4ka) became one company at the turn of 2021 to 2022; home and mobile service trades as 4ka, business service as SWAN.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Slovak Telekom
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Cited for names and dates (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: Read on the date above for former names: T-Mobile Slovensko and EuroTel.

providers.name: O2 Slovakia
providers.notes: No AS number is registered to it.

providers.name: SWAN
providers.notes: Business lines trade as SWAN, home and mobile service as 4ka. AS5578 carries the AS name BENESTRA.

providers.name: SANET
